errors.evidence: The description mentions only two of the three grouping labels on the x-axis, omitting the middle one: „Честота на актуализиране на информацията:“ (Frequency of information update).
The description states there are two subsections on the x-axis, but the figure clearly shows three grouping labels at the bottom.
The category label in the chart is „абонамент на периодиkа“, not „абонамент на периода“.

The list of categories with a value of 0 is incomplete. It omits „дарение от авторите, чиято цитатна активност се следи“ and one of the instances of „друго (посочете какво)“, both of which have a value of 0.
The description of the vertical axis does not specify the range of values (0 to 12) or the interval of the gridlines (every 1 unit), which are visible in the chart.
